Worldwide net sales and revenues: critic raised a concrete objection: Wrong basis: the YoY inputs you used are not for the same metric you’re forecasting. You cite FY2024Q3→FY2025Q3 growth of −8.6%, but Deere’s own disclosure for the target metric (“worldwide net sales and revenues”) says Q3 FY2025 decreased 9% to $12.018 billion. Using −8.6% suggests you pulled a different series (likely Equipment Operations net sales) to drive the roll-forward, so the FY2026Q3 figure is computed on a mismatched basis.
